name: Marenza
summary: Marenza is conceived as a study in sculptural form, its fiberglass frame and layered boards finished in a refined dual-tone palette. The smooth surfaces flow with architectural clarity, while the interplay of contrasting shades introduces rhythm and depth. Minimal yet commanding, it reflects a vision of modern luxury where design becomes both structure and art.
